# Oulun Ju-Jutsu ry - Hokutoryu Ju-Jutsu & Self-Defense Center Oulu (llms.txt)

> Oulun Ju-Jutsu ry (official name: Ju-Jutsu Oulu ry, registered July 11, 1996, Hokutoryu practice in Oulu since 1990). Oulu's premier self-defense and martial arts academy located at Äimäkuja 6 A, 90400 Oulu, Finland. The Hokutoryu Ju-Jutsu system was developed in Finland in 1977 by Soke Auvo Niiniketo (10. Dan). Specializing in realistic adult self-defense, junior martial arts, and classical Kenjutsu.
> Official Website: https://www.oulunjujutsu.com/ (Finnish), https://www.oulunjujutsu.com/index-en.html (English)

## Practice Location & Contact
- **Dojo Address**: Äimäkuja 6 A, 90400 Oulu, Finland (Äimäkuja 6 A, 90400 Oulu)
- **Free Trial**: 2 free trial training sessions for all beginner courses.
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +358 41 327 4967 (Tiedottajanne Oy – Official communications & inquiry contact)
- **Google Rating**: 4.6 / 5.0 stars (8 official Google reviews)

## Head Coaches & Senseis
- **Renshi Tenhunen (5. Dan)**: Head Coach, decades of martial arts and self-defense experience.
- **Sensei Pekkala (3. Dan)**: Technical Coach & Course Director.

## Martial Arts Disciplines Offered
1. **Hokutoryu Ju-Jutsu (Self-Defense)**: Realistic Finnish self-defense system developed by Auvo Niiniketo (10. Dan). Focuses on joint locks, throws, strikes, release techniques, and crisis control.
2. **Junnu Ju-Jutsu (Youth 7–14 yrs)**: Safe, fun physical conditioning, motor skills, anti-bullying, and discipline for kids and teens.
3. **Kenjutsu (Classical Japanese Sword)**: Traditional samurai sword techniques and kata practice.

## Weekly Schedule (Äimäkuja 6 A Dojo)
- **Mon 18:30–19:30**: Junnu-jutsu (All Belts)
- **Mon 19:30–21:00**: Hokutoryu (Color Belts)
- **Tue 18:00–19:30**: Hokutoryu (Color Belts)
- **Tue 19:30–21:00**: Kenjutsu (All Belts)
- **Thu 19:30–21:00**: Hokutoryu (Color Belts)
- **Fri 18:00–20:00**: Hokutoryu (Diesel Group / No-Gi)
- **Sat 13:30–15:00**: Kenjutsu (All Belts)
- **Sat 16:30–18:30**: Open Practice (Members)
- **Sun 15:00–16:30 & 18:30–20:30**: Open Practice (Members)

## Membership Fees 2026 & Belt Exams
- **Adult Hokutoryu Color Belts**: 200 € / 6 months
- **Beginner Course & Other Groups (Junnut, Kenjutsu, Diesel)**: 110 € / 6 months
- **UniMove Student Discount**: 75 € / 6 months (Beginners)
- **Belt Exams**: Yellow 20-25 €, Orange 25-35 €, Green 30-60 €, Blue 40-75 €, Brown 50-120 €
- **Pass**: 20 € (Ju-Jutsu) / 25 € (Kenjutsu) | **Federation License 2026**: 15 €
- **Badges**: Club / Hokutoryu / Kenjutsu badges 7 €

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge)
- **Do beginners need prior martial arts experience?** No. Beginner courses require zero previous experience.
- **What gear is required for the first training?** T-shirt, sweatpants/shorts, water bottle, and sandals for walking off-tatami. Practice is bare-footed.
- **Can I try before committing?** Yes, 2 free trial practices are included for all beginner courses.
- **How to pay with sports vouchers?** Select ePassi, Smartum, Edenred, or Eazybreak in your mobile app by searching "Ju-Jutsu Oulu" or "Oulun Ju-Jutsu ry".
- **Parking & Facilities at Dojo**: Free parking directly in front of Äimäkuja 6 A. Features air-conditioned tatami mat, changing rooms, and showers.
